integrity: Proof and reproducibility claims are scientific; the checks are finite and do not certify the infinite formulas. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The Ehrhart statement assumes \(n\ge4\) and \(2\le k\le\lfloor n/2\rfloor\), with deleted edges forming a matching. Metric deformations require all other lengths equal to one and each modified pair distance in \([1,2]\). Historical priority is provisional; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Matching-deletion Ehrhart formula and additive polar-volume law for complete graph metrics
